scope: Paper 3 assisted audit: 180 records and 11 conceptual dimensions

contract_invariants.contextual_marks: When the reviewer literal is an unequivocal IDEM mark, use the value resolved from the folio sequence; otherwise use the literal value.
contract_invariants.date: Compare resolved month and day with fecha_reconstruida; do not penalize the absence of the literal repetition mark in the legacy baseline.
contract_invariants.missing: Map missing values to the empty string; an empty-empty comparison counts as agreement in the primary metric and is removed only in the separately reported informative-comparison sensitivity.
contract_invariants.horizontal_rule: A horizontal absence mark is missing data and never propagates the preceding value.
contract_invariants.non_retroactivity: The comparator does not modify the baseline and does not impose prospective literal-layer requirements on the legacy extraction.

general_formal: map ordinal symbols º and ° to o
replace non-word character runs with one space
comparators.age: Parse numeric values; integral representations such as 16 and 16.0 are equivalent; otherwise use the general formal comparator.
comparators.course: Apply the general formal comparator; extract the first standalone digit 1-9 with an optional ordinal suffix; retain orientation only when letras or a ciencias root is explicit; compare number|orientation.
comparators.nationality: Apply the general formal comparator, then map only the explicitly enumerated historical abbreviations, demonyms and labels to the corresponding country category.

sensitivity_scenarios.estricto_resuelto_tipado: Preserve case, accents and punctuation after trimming; retain numeric equivalence for age and resolved comparison for dates and contextual marks.
sensitivity_scenarios.minusculas_y_espacios: Add lowercasing and whitespace collapse only.
sensitivity_scenarios.normalizacion_formal: Add diacritic, punctuation and ordinal-symbol normalization, without semantic recoding of course or nationality.
sensitivity_scenarios.principal_sin_recodificacion_nacionalida: Use the course comparator but not the nationality map.
sensitivity_scenarios.principal_sin_canonizacion_curso: Use the nationality map but not course canonicalization.
sensitivity_scenarios.principal_reportado: Use general formal, typed age, resolved date/context, course canonicalization and the enumerated nationality map.

prohibited_inferences: Do not modernize a historical spelling by plausibility.
Do not infer a course orientation that is not explicit.
Do not extend the nationality dictionary case by case after inspecting disagreements.
Do not treat a QA flag as proof of error.
Do not adjudicate the five disagreements between independent reviewers.
